audience: service businesses and their staff who take bookings with Acuity Scheduling

useCases.title: Find open times for an appointment type
useCases.text: The AI checks which dates in a month have availability and lists the open time slots on a day for one appointment type. You get the next open slots without opening the calendar.

useCases.title: Review the appointments for a day or week
useCases.text: The AI lists appointments with filters and can open a single appointment. It groups them by calendar or client and shows time, type and who booked.

useCases.title: Book a client, and add them if new
useCases.text: The AI finds an open slot, checks the client list for the person, creates the client if needed and books the appointment. Acuity may send the confirmation email.

useCases.title: Reschedule or cancel an appointment
useCases.text: The AI finds the appointment by client and date, then moves it to a new time or cancels it. Acuity may send an update or cancellation email to the client.

useCases.title: See which group classes have space
useCases.text: The AI lists the group class time slots in a month for class-type appointment types. You see which classes are scheduled and when.
